name: Blood & Play
source:
Blood & Play is a gay, safe for work, T4T visual novel that can be a romantic-comedy or a macabre psychological horror story depending on how you guide Santiago to interpret an offer that's hard to ignore.

Poor Santiago is unfortunately one of many hit by the latest wave of tech industry redundancies, and without a decent job offer he's willing to take, he's desperate for a stream of income; it's too bad that the blood plasma donation center near his apartment is indefinitely closed for renovations. Just before all hope is lost though, a stranger passing by offers him some company for the evening, and much, much more not too long after...

But... there's always a catch to these things, isn't there?

[From [url=https://tofurocks.itch.io/blood-play]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Blood & Play》是一部同性恋、工作安全的T4T视觉小说，它可以是一部浪漫喜剧，也可以是一个恐怖的心理恐怖故事，具体取决于你如何引导圣地亚哥解读一个难以忽视的提议。

不幸的是，可怜的圣地亚哥是受到最新一波科技行业裁员浪潮打击的众多人之一，由于没有他愿意接受的体面工作机会，他迫切需要一份收入来源；可惜的是，他公寓附近的血浆捐献中心因装修而无限期关闭。然而，就在所有希望破灭之前，一个路过的陌生人为他提供了晚上的陪伴，不久之后，还有更多、更多的陪伴……

但是……这些事情总有一个陷阱，不是吗？

[来自[url=https://tofurocks.itch.io/blood-play]itch.io[/url]]
